name: Ferrochem VeriLab Technician's Full Rig
description: Slate-blue lab coat in anti-static synth-cotton over matching trousers, both tagged with a corponation-issued QR strip at the collar and cuff. Safety goggles with anti-fog coating sit over a fitted cap that covers neural port access points. Powder-free nitrile gloves in sterile violet seal at the wrist with a snap-ring, and low-profile closed-toe lab shoes in white rubber-composite complete the look. A lightweight chest panel holds labeled reagent vials, calibration tools, and a compact sample scanner.
functionality: Anti-static fabric prevents sample contamination near sensitive equipment; chest panel organizes consumables for rapid bench-to-bench workflow.
what_it_says: This person follows the protocol exactly, every time, because the protocol is what keeps the results clean and the job secure.
story_hooks: A sample vial in the chest panel is labeled in handwriting that doesn't match the tech's — and the compound inside isn't in any catalog.
The QR tag at the collar has been subtly altered; it still scans correctly, but the access level it grants is two tiers above this worker's clearance.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A crisp, utilitarian ensemble projecting clinical precision and corporate authority. The slate-blue color palette reads as both professional and sterile, creating a visual hierarchy from torso (lab coat) down through matched trousers to grounded white footwear. The silhouette is neat and contained—no excess fabric, every element locked in place. Goggles rest high on the face; the fitted cap creates a sealed appearance around the head. Overall impression: a body optimized for controlled environments and measurable work.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not form-fitting; the lab coat sits straight from shoulder to mid-thigh with minimal taper. Trousers are straight-leg with a slight taper at the ankle. The cap is snug to the scalp. All closures are deliberate and secure—nothing loose or billowing. Movement is unrestricted but contained.
physical_description.primary_material: Anti-static synth-cotton blend (lab coat and trousers), treated polymer cap with mesh ventilation panels, borosilicate/polycarbonate lenses (goggles), powder-free nitrile gloves (violet-dyed for sterile tracking), white rubber-composite shoe uppers with non-slip tread
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly matte synth-cotton with a soft nap; cool to the touch. Goggles have a smooth, hard finish with slight anti-reflective coating visible at certain angles. Gloves are thin, elastic, and tactilely responsive. Shoes have a slightly tacky, non-slip sole surface.
physical_description.color_scheme: Slate-blue (primary) across coat and trousers; bright violet accent gloves; white goggles frame and shoe uppers; gunmetal-gray QR strips at collar and cuff; chrome or silver-tone snap-rings and tool fixtures on chest panel
physical_description.closures: Magnetic-snap placket on lab coat (silent, secure, anti-static); friction-fit trousers with hidden elasticated waistband; snap-ring glove seals at wrist; velcro-backed QR tags (non-removable without leaving residue); goggles secured with adjustable silicone strap
distinctive_features: Ferrochem corporate QR strip at collar and cuff (encrypted employee ID and clearance level)
Integrated chest panel with labeled reagent vial holders and calibration tool slots
Compact sample scanner holster (magnetic attachment point)
Anti-static fabric throughout (conductive microscopic fiber grid visible under close inspection)
Anti-fog coating on goggles (hydrophilic surface prevents condensation)
Neural port-access fitted cap with discrete mesh panels for thermal regulation
Powder-free nitrile gloves in non-standard violet (enables real-time particle tracking in lab systems)
Non-slip rubber-composite shoe sole with geometric tread pattern
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury/corporate equipment—this is mid-to-high-tier corpo issue, expensive enough to be tracked, standardized enough to be issued to qualified technicians at Ferrochem facilities
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals a laboratory technician or researcher with corpo affiliation and security clearance. Wearer is trusted with sensitive biotech or chemical work. The gear says: regulated, credentialed, compliant, and loyal to Ferrochem. Street-tier individuals would never own this—it's non-transferable property.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Ferrochem washes and inspects these rigs weekly. QR tags remain crisp and scannable. Goggles are replaced at the first sign of scratch or coating degradation. Gloves are single-use; a fresh pair is issued daily. The look is always clean, organized, and inspection-ready.
